verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no GA4 feature for user-defined automations that run on their own, such as scheduled reports, triggered alerts, or recurring workflows. The Data API and Admin API 'automate' wording describes developer building blocks for building such automation externally. The BigQuery daily and continuous export is a fixed data-export feature, not a configurable automation, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
